import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static class VecType {
        long[] vals = new long[30];
    }

    static class MatType {
        long[][] mat = new long[30][30];
    }

    static long totalN, baseK;
    static MatType[] matricesArr = new MatType[30];
    static MatType[] invMatricesArr = new MatType[30];
    static MatType[][] E = new MatType[200][40], EI = new MatType[200][40];
    static VecType currentVec = new VecType();

    static long getVal(long num) {
        if (num < baseK) return num;
        return (num + getVal(num / baseK)) % baseK;
    }

    static MatType multiplyMat(MatType a, MatType b) {
        MatType res = new MatType();
        for (int i = 0; i < baseK; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < baseK; j++) {
                res.mat[i][j] = 0;
                for (int l = 0; l < baseK; l++) {
                    res.mat[i][j] += (a.mat[i][l] * b.mat[l][j]) % MOD;
                }
                res.mat[i][j] %= MOD;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static VecType multiplyMatVec(MatType m, VecType v) {
        VecType res = new VecType();
        for (int i = 0; i < baseK; i++) {
            res.vals[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < baseK; j++) {
                res.vals[i] += (v.vals[j] * m.mat[i][j]) % MOD;
            }
            res.vals[i] %= MOD;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void precompute() {
        for (int i = 0; i < baseK; i++) {
            E[0][i] = matricesArr[i];
            EI[0][i] = invMatricesArr[i];
        }
        int LOG = 0;
        long t = totalN;
        while (t > 0) {
            LOG++;
            t /= baseK;
        }
        for (int j = 1; j <= LOG; j++) {
            E[j][0] = E[j - 1][0];
            EI[j][0] = EI[j - 1][0];
            for (int l = 1; l < baseK; l++) {
                E[j][0] = multiplyMat(E[j - 1][l], E[j][0]);
                EI[j][0] = multiplyMat(EI[j][0], EI[j - 1][l]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < baseK; i++) {
                E[j][i] = multiplyMat(E[j - 1][i - 1], multiplyMat(E[j][i - 1], EI[j - 1][i - 1]));
                EI[j][i] = multiplyMat(E[j - 1][i - 1], multiplyMat(EI[j][i - 1], EI[j - 1][i - 1]));
            }
        }
    }

    static VecType solveVec(long n, VecType v, int at) {
        if (n == 0) return v;
        int w = (int) getVal(n / baseK);
        v = solveVec(n / baseK, v, at + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < n % baseK; i++) {
            v = multiplyMatVec(E[at][(w + i) % baseK], v);
        }
        return v;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        totalN = sc.nextLong();
        baseK = sc.nextLong();

        for (int i = 0; i < baseK; i++) {
            currentVec.vals[i] = 1;
            matricesArr[i] = new MatType();
            invMatricesArr[i] = new MatType();
            for (int j = 0; j < baseK; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < baseK; l++) {
                    if (j == l) {
                        matricesArr[i].mat[j][l] = 1;
                        invMatricesArr[i].mat[j][l] = 1;
                    } else if (j == i) {
                        matricesArr[i].mat[j][l] = 1;
                        invMatricesArr[i].mat[j][l] = -1;
                    } else {
                        matricesArr[i].mat[j][l] = 0;
                        invMatricesArr[i].mat[j][l] = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        precompute();
        currentVec = solveVec(totalN, currentVec, 0);
        long totalSum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < baseK; i++) {
            totalSum += currentVec.vals[i];
        }
        totalSum--;
        totalSum %= MOD;
        if (totalSum < 0) totalSum += MOD;
        while (totalSum % (baseK - 1) != 0) {
            totalSum += MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(totalSum / (baseK - 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
